description:
[Calculators] Blueprint tracker: what you've unlocked and the scrap, fragments, pages and books left. The blueprint tracker page (https://rust.wiki/calculators/blueprints) for a list of blueprints you have. Tech
tree blueprints cost research items, not scrap: 1 Blueprint Fragment each on the Workbench Level 1 and Engineering
Workbench trees, 1 Blueprint Page on Level 2, 1 Blueprint Book on Level 3 (game default; a server can add a tax).
Unlocking one also unlocks every locked blueprint on the cheapest route to it, 1 item each. `trees` gives, per
tree, the blueprints unlocked, the research items spent and left, and the cheapest locked ones with `cost_now`
(what reaching it costs from what you have). `research_items` totals those per item. `research_table` is the
Research Table side: scrap by rarity (20/40/100/300, default blueprints 10), spent and left. `page` opens the
tracker with the same ticks. The full list is /calculators/blueprints. Give the user the page link: it opens the tracker with their blueprints ticked. Tech tree blueprints cost Blueprint Fragments/Pages/Books, never scrap.

remaining.description: How many still-locked blueprints to list per tech tree and for the Research Table (cheapest first).

unlocked.description: Comma-separated shortnames (or names) of the blueprints you have. Left out = nothing unlocked yet.
